about_the_game:
Can you protect her… or will you be the next one in need of help?

My Sleeping Girlfriend is a first-person psychological horror game where the danger doesn’t come from outside, but from the one sleeping next to you.

What’s included in the demo?

In this trial version, you will experience the first night after moving into a new home with your girlfriend. Everything seems normal… until you discover her disturbing secret: she’s a sleepwalker.

  • Explore the dark house as you search for your girlfriend.

  • Observe her behavior: is she acting normally… or is there something more?

  • Choose wisely: will you take her back to bed or wake her up? A wrong decision can be fatal.

This demo offers 10-15 minutes of psychological horror with multiple possible endings.

Warning: This game contains violent scenes, disturbing images, and moments designed to unsettle, which may not be suitable for all players.
